notes.body: Patty Press, week of Aug 31 — read it and share it. Six items: National Cheeseburger Day forecast, new bread info, Blackberry Shake deactivation, proactive Freestyle service, holiday bread delivery, beef prices lowering.

Recognition for Bec (Outer Loop) — took a closing shift at Etown on her day off after 47 hours, store was pristine the next morning. Brad: “Outstanding Job Bec - way to represent & thank you!” Read it at huddle.

3rd reminder — incident #26-22677, Produce Lettuce, 24 cases claimed. Corporate needs more photos: “I am only seeing 4 heads of lettuce and you are claiming 24.” Auto-resolves with no credit ~Tue 9/8.
Labor Day week delivery shift: Monday deliveries move to Tuesday, Tuesday to Wednesday. Order Sunday for Tuesday, Tuesday for Wednesday. Thu/Fri/Sat unchanged.
Two shops posted: 8/27 Dinner 100% (Bobby, Madison) and 8/30 Lunch 0.0% (Brianna Gatewood, Vicki Lucey). Action plan drafted for the 8/30 shop.
Martel Miller did not pass the background check — not moving forward. Not added to the employee directory; active count unchanged.
